drums.description: Funk and disco-pop fusion, A clean, DI-style electric guitar plays a syncopated rhythmic pattern using 16th-note scratches and palm-muted staccato chords, A bright, resonant acoustic guitar doubles the rhythmic accents, The bass guitar performs a melodic, walking line with frequent slides and percussive pops, A dry drum kit features a tight, high-tuned snare and a crisp hi-hat playing consistent 16th-note subdivisions with occasional open-hat accents, Handclaps are layered on the backbeat, The arrangement is centered in C major at 115 BPM Publish

bass.description: Lo-fi hip hop beat, A Rhodes electric piano plays a jazz-influenced four-bar progression with a soft tremolo effect, The drum kit features a muffled, low-pass filtered kick drum and a crisp snare with a slight swing, A sub-bass synth follows the root notes of the piano chords, A recurring vinyl crackle and hiss layer persists throughout the track, A high-pitched, filtered synth lead enters with a simple, melodic motif using long sustain, 85 BPM, Key of C minor, 4/4 time Publish
